entries.headline: US transports, airborne radar and elevated Baltic activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US military transport aircraft and an airborne radar aircraft over the continental United States, while Baltic-region air activity was nearly three times its stated normal level.

entries.headline: Six US strategic aircraft and coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force strategic aircraft over the continental United States: a nuclear command aircraft, two surveillance aircraft and three cargo aircraft. It also reported one coded broadcast during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: US cargo and radar-surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force cargo aircraft and a radar-surveillance aircraft over the continental United States, amid rising tensions involving Ukraine and the Middle East.

entries.headline: War Watch shares Reuters report on deadly eastern Ukraine strike
entries.summary: War Watch shared a Reuters report that a Russian bomb killed 33 people on a street in an eastern Ukrainian stronghold, attributing the item to Robertchester-j5b.

entries.headline: US transports and airborne radar aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and an airborne radar aircraft over the United States, with no coded radio alerts detected during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: War Watch shares Guardian report on deadly bus attack
entries.summary: War Watch shared a Guardian report that a Russian attack on a bus killed 30 people near the front line in Ukraine, attributing the item to Robertchester-j5b.

entries.headline: US transports, command aircraft and elevated Black Sea activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, while Black Sea military air activity was nearly three times its stated normal level.

entries.headline: War Watch shares reports of Royal Navy sailor arrest
entries.summary: War Watch shared Sky News and BBC reports that a junior-ranking Royal Navy sailor had been arrested over alleged spying for Russia, attributing the item to Robertchester-j5b.

entries.headline: US transports over North America and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US Air Force transport aircraft over North America and the North Sea, alongside a report that the Pentagon was preparing for a potential conflict with Iran.

entries.headline: Six US transports through Ramstein reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft moving through Ramstein Air Base, Germany, during the preceding few hours, amid reports of Ukrainian strikes on Russian targets.

entries.headline: Explosions reported in Bandar Abbas
entries.summary: War Watch reported extremely powerful explosions in Bandar Abbas between 0900 and 0910 local time, or 0530Z to 0540Z, attributing the report to weslester6474.

entries.headline: US transports over the United States and Europe reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, with several near Ramstein Air Base during active military operations.

entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report saying China’s military was adapting its tactics for drone-centred conflict based on lessons from the war in Ukraine.
